subCategories.name: Metals
subCategories.description: Recovery and refinement of metal materials including gallium

subCategories.name: Photovoltaic Panels
subCategories.description: Tracking disassembly and material recovery from photovoltaic panels

subCategories.name: Printed Circuit Boards (PCB)
subCategories.description: Precious metal recovery process from electronic circuit boards

stream:
dpp:
  enabled: true
  gtin: '09506000134352'
  lotDefault: ''
  lotInputKey: batchId
  ownerName: Attesta Demo Operator
  productDescription: Gallium intake and refinement process with notarized checkpoints.
  productName: Recycled Gallium Batch
  serialInputKey: ''
  serialStrategy: ''

organizations:
  - name: Organization 1
    slug: organization-1
  - name: Organization 2
    slug: organization-2
  - name: Organization 3
    slug: organization-3

roles:
  - name: Chemist
    orgSlug: organization-1
    slug: chemist
  - name: Mechanic
    orgSlug: organization-1
    slug: mechanic
  - name: Supervisor
    orgSlug: organization-1
    slug: supervisor
  - name: Analyst
    orgSlug: organization-2
    slug: analyst
  - name: QA Inspector
    orgSlug: organization-3
    slug: qainspector

workflow:
  description: Workflow for intake, refinement, and QA of recycled gallium batches
    with notarized checkpoints.
  name: Gallium recycling notarization
  steps:
    - id: '1'
      order: 1
      organization: organization-1
      substeps:
        - id: '1.1'
          inputKey: qa
          inputType: formata
          order: 0
          roles:
            - chemist
          schema:
            properties:
              confidenceLevel:
                maximum: 5
                minimum: 1
                title: Confidence level (range 1-5)
                type: integer
              evidenceFile:
                format: data-url
                title: Evidence file
                type: string
              inspectorName:
                title: Inspector name
                type: string
              notes:
                title: QA notes
                type: string
              purityScore:
                maximum: 100
                minimum: 0
                title: Purity score (range 0-100)
                type: number
              result:
                enum:
                  - pass
                  - conditional_pass
                  - rework
                  - reject
                title: QA result
                type: string
              riskBand:
                enum:
                  - low
                  - medium
                  - high
                  - critical
                title: Risk band
                type: string
              testMethod:
                enum:
                  - xrf
                  - icp_ms
                  - wet_chemistry
                  - visual_only
                title: Test method
                type: string
            required:
              - inspectorName
              - result
              - purityScore
              - riskBand
            type: object
          title: Record formata
          uiSchema:
            confidenceLevel:
              ui:components:
                numberWidget: rangeWidget
              ui:options:
                help: Numeric range value between 1 and 5.
            evidenceFile:
              ui:components:
                stringField: fileField
              ui:options:
                help: Upload QA evidence.
            notes:
              ui:components:
                textWidget: textareaWidget
              ui:options:
                help: Write a detailed QA narrative and exceptions.
            purityScore:
              ui:components:
                numberWidget: rangeWidget
              ui:options:
                help: Numeric range value between 0 and 100.
            riskBand:
              ui:options:
                help: Choose the risk classification for this batch.
            testMethod:
              ui:options:
                help: Select how QA validation was performed.
            ui:options:
              order:
                - inspectorName
                - testMethod
                - result
                - riskBand
                - purityScore
                - confidenceLevel
                - notes
                - evidenceFile
        - id: '1.2'
          inputKey: incomingKg
          inputType: formata
          order: 1
          roles:
            - mechanic
          schema:
            properties:
              incomingKg:
                title: incomingKg
                type: number
            required:
              - incomingKg
            title: Record incoming gallium
            type: object
          title: Record incoming gallium (kg)
        - id: '1.3'
          inputKey: batchId
          inputType: formata
          order: 2
          roles:
            - supervisor
          schema:
            properties:
              batchId:
                title: batchId
                type: string
            required:
              - batchId
            title: Batch ID reference
            type: object
          title: Attach batch ID
        - id: '1.4'
          inputKey: Gallium certification
          inputType: formata
          order: 3
          roles:
            - supervisor
          schema:
            properties:
              Certification:
                title: Certification
            required:
              - Certification
            title: Gallium certification
            type: object
          title: Upload gallium certification
          uiSchema:
            Certification:
              ui:components:
                unknownField: unknownNativeFileField
      title: Incoming intake
    - id: '2'
      order: 2
      organization: organization-2
      substeps:
        - id: '2.1'
          inputKey: refinedKg
          inputType: formata
          order: 1
          roles:
            - analyst
          schema:
            properties:
              refinedKg:
                title: refinedKg
                type: number
            required:
              - refinedKg
            title: Record refined gallium output
            type: object
          title: Record refined gallium output (kg)
        - id: '2.2'
          inputKey: purityPct
          inputType: formata
          order: 2
          roles:
            - analyst
          schema:
            properties:
              purityPct:
                title: purityPct
                type: number
            required:
              - purityPct
            title: Record purity percentage
            type: object
          title: Record purity (%)
      title: Refinement
    - id: '3'
      order: 3
      organization: organization-3
      substeps:
        - id: '3.1'
          inputKey: qaChecklist
          inputType: formata
          order: 1
          roles:
            - qainspector
          schema:
            properties:
              confidenceLevel:
                maximum: 5
                minimum: 1
                title: Confidence level (range 1-5)
                type: integer
              evidenceFile:
                format: data-url
                title: Evidence file
                type: string
              inspectorName:
                title: Inspector name
                type: string
              notes:
                title: QA notes
                type: string
              purityScore:
                maximum: 100
                minimum: 0
                title: Purity score (range 0-100)
                type: number
              result:
                enum:
                  - pass
                  - conditional_pass
                  - rework
                  - reject
                title: QA result
                type: string
              riskBand:
                enum:
                  - low
                  - medium
                  - high
                  - critical
                title: Risk band
                type: string
              testMethod:
                enum:
                  - xrf
                  - icp_ms
                  - wet_chemistry
                  - visual_only
                title: Test method
                type: string
            required:
              - inspectorName
              - result
              - purityScore
              - riskBand
            type: object
          title: QA sign-off
          uiSchema:
            confidenceLevel:
              ui:components:
                numberWidget: rangeWidget
              ui:options:
                help: Numeric range value between 1 and 5.
            evidenceFile:
              ui:components:
                stringField: fileField
              ui:options:
                help: Upload QA evidence.
            notes:
              ui:components:
                textWidget: textareaWidget
              ui:options:
                help: Write a detailed QA narrative and exceptions.
            purityScore:
              ui:components:
                numberWidget: rangeWidget
              ui:options:
                help: Numeric range value between 0 and 100.
            riskBand:
              ui:options:
                help: Choose the risk classification for this batch.
            testMethod:
              ui:options:
                help: Select how QA validation was performed.
            ui:options:
              order:
                - inspectorName
                - testMethod
                - result
                - riskBand
                - purityScore
                - confidenceLevel
                - notes
                - evidenceFile
        - id: '3.2'
          inputKey: finalHash
          inputType: formata
          order: 2
          roles:
            - qainspector
          schema:
            properties:
              finalHash:
                title: finalHash
                type: string
            required:
              - finalHash
            title: Final hash
            type: object
          title: Finalize notarization
      title: QA + Notarize
